thread:
jamie: Morning team — first day. Trying to enroll my personal ThinkPad (Ubuntu 22.04) into FleetDM/Kandji for device trust so I can access private repo + VPN. Getting blocked when loading tun module for WireGuard. fleetctl enroll also returns a 403 (device non-compliant). Can @it-support advise?

it-support: Welcome, Jamie! We usually prefer company machines but we can help on a case-by-case basis. Can you paste `uname -a`, `lsblk -f`, and the last few lines of `dmesg`? Also confirm if Secure Boot is enabled.

jamie: sure — outputs below:
`uname -a` -> Linux thinkpad-13 5.15.0-58-generic #64-Ubuntu SMP x86_64 GNU/Linux
`lsblk -f` -> sda: ext4, sda2: crypto_LUKS
`sudo dmesg | tail` -> 
"[12345.678901] Kernel panic... jk just error loading tun:
[12345.679001] tun: Unknown symbol in module
"
Also `sudo modprobe tun` -> `modprobe: FATAL: Module tun not found in directory /lib/modules/5.15.0-58-generic`

alex: Looks like your kernel doesn't have the tun module available (custom kernel or headers missing). Common fixes: install matching linux-headers and dkms build, or use distro-provided kernel. But Kandji's policy blocks loading unsigned kernel modules if Secure Boot is enabled.

maria: Heads-up — for personal devices we require a signed exception form (security sign-off) before we allow elevated access. I'll DM the form. :shield:

kandji-bot: Policy alert — Device non-compliant: kernel module load blocked by policy (tun). Network access limited. Ticket created: POL-4521.

it-support: Two options: 1) We can spin up a temporary cloud dev-jumpbox with full repo/VPN access (no device enrollment) — fastest. 2) Grant a 1-hour TempAdmin window so you can install headers and enroll (requires signed exception). Which do you prefer?

jamie: probably jumpbox to get started. If I still need dev tools installed later I'll fill the form and request TempAdmin.

sre-oncall: Done — created dev-guest-23. SSH details sent via DM. VPN-lite and git access available. TTL 72h. If you actually need port-forwarding for local dev, tell me and I'll extend to 7 days.

jamie: Awesome, thanks everyone — trying the jumpbox now. Appreciate the quick responses :rocket:
